_comment: Hand-verified overrides for the primary-sense/reading selection heuristic in app/services/cedict_loader.py. Each entry here was checked against raw CC-CEDICT + SUBTLEX-CH frequency data and confirmed by a human, not auto-generated. See the 2026-07 audit in project memory for methodology. Extend this list incrementally as new misfires are found -- do not bulk-generate from frequency data alone (frequency is a strong signal but not always right, e.g. structural heuristics correctly keep 便宜 as 'cheap' despite lower measured frequency than its 'convenient' reading).
